svg.title: Contextual trust calibration and evidence-aware updates
svg.desc: The calibration chain from declared skill to calibrated capability, the trust gate applied to a declared skill, the evidence hierarchy used for credit assignment, and the posterior means after a single recorded outcome.

svg.text: Pair synergy receives a residual, not full team credit:

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif
'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: so a pair whose members already scored well individually gains nothing.

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: A requirement-level score updates that agent’s requirement posterior at

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: full weight; without one, the agent’s attributed credit is reused at its

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: own, lower weight. Quoted versus actual cost and latency update a separate

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: fidelity posterior that inflates future quotes from the same agent.

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: (c) Credit follows the strongest available evidence

svg.text: The auditor and the retriever gain most; the already-strong pair slips below the prior.

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: (d) Posterior means after one recorded outcome (prior 0.500)

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: This is evidence-weighted attribution, not causal credit assignment. Logged propensities, randomised exploration and doubly robust off-policy evaluation are still required for production learning.
